name: AECi — Data quality check found WARN-severity issues (by check)
message:
A §23.1 data-quality check found one or more **warn-severity** issues in the daily run (AECI-279 / Phase 8.1 split of the AECI-241 monitor). These are hygiene findings, not integrity faults — the eight warn checks are `products_without_vendor`, `ready_products_unpromoted`, `vendors_without_products`, `stale_stats_cache`, `duplicate_vendors`, `duplicate_products`, `logo_404`, and `algolia_index_drift`. The alert is split `by {check}`, so the offending check is named in the alert tags; the gauge value is the issue count (the per-check gauge is emitted every run, 0 when clean, so this only fires on a real finding). **This is informational / non-paging** — the daily email digest to Chris + Bill already carries these rows, and `algolia_index_drift` additionally has its own dedicated drift monitor. It exists so warn findings surface in the Datadog UI and can be tuned or muted independently of the error-severity pager (the whole point of the AECI-279 split). Triage in the digest; the next daily run re-checks.

Note: notify_no_data is OFF here — liveness is the companion 'AECi — Data quality job not running' monitor. Per-check thresholds (e.g. tolerate N known duplicate candidates) are launch-tunable — this is the monitor to relax first if a warn check proves noisy.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#data-quality-job-failed-or-not-running
